messages:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: Incident alert: High error rate for tenant aurelia-corp in eu-west-1 (dedicated). Pager routed to oncall.
Robin (oncall): I’m on it. Seeing 5xx surge from that tenant, spikes at the dedicated pool level.
Maya (SRE): Confirmed. Errors originate at the edge -> lb -> dedicated pool (eu-west-1-pool-3). Latency also up. Looks like intermittent network flaps between our nodes and the tenant VPC.
Samir (Eng-Platform): We should plan a regional warm shift to eu-west-2. Can we spin up warm capacity there and shift traffic via DNS/CNAME? Need to avoid data plane disruption with the VPC.
Chris (Infra): eu-west-2 has available reserved nodes. I can allocate a warm dedicated pool (eu-west-2-warm-01) now. Will also prep VPC peering/privatelink configs.
Elaine (Account Exec): I’m on the line with Aurelia. They're seeing production impact on their materialization jobs. They need an ETA and reassurance about no data loss.
Aurelia-SRE (customer): Thanks – we’re seeing ~30% failures on inference endpoints. Our ops team is ready to accept traffic on eu-west-2 if you can cut over.
Robin (oncall): Plan: 1) Provision warm pool in eu-west-2. 2) Warm model + KV cache. 3) Run smoke tests. 4) Lower DNS TTL (to 60) and authoritatively update CNAME -> new LB. 5) Monitor and roll back if errors > threshold. Assigning tasks below.
Chris (Infra): Provisioning pool now. ETA ~8 minutes. Creating security groups and route entries for VPC peering.
Maya (SRE): While Chris provisions, I’ll start a parallel deploy to the warm pool and pre-load the models and KV caches. Running quick sanity scripts to ensure same model digest/version.
Samir (Eng-Platform): Reminder: we have an automated route helper:
```
# pre-run health checks
redwood infra check --tenant aurelia-corp --region eu-west-2
# set routing pref (dry-run)
redwood route set --tenant aurelia-corp --region eu-west-2 --weight 0 --dry-run
```
I’ll be on the console during the DNS switch.
Chris (Infra): eu-west-2-warm-01 created. Instance IDs: i-0a1b2c3d. Security groups and peering in place. I pushed a temporary NAT/route so traffic can reach the customer's VPC via privatelink.
Maya (SRE): Models deployed and warmed. KV cache primed with recent prefixes. Running smoke test now.
Maya (SRE): Smoke tests: generate -> OK, embeddings -> OK, latency within target. No 5xx observed on warm pool.
Robin (oncall): Good. Lowering DNS TTL now to 60s on our zone for aurelia-corp.redwood.ai.
Samir (Eng-Platform): TTL lowered. Preparing CNAME to point to eu-west-2 LB (lb-eu-west-2-aurelia). Will perform a staged weight shift using edge route controls.
Elaine (Account Exec): Communicating to Aurelia: we will start shifting traffic in ~2 minutes. Please keep your team standing by to confirm if they see success.
Aurelia-SRE (customer): We’re ready to observe.
Samir (Eng-Platform): Initiating staged weight changes: 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100%, 90s dwell between steps. Running command:
```
redwood route set --tenant aurelia-corp --region eu-west-2 --weight 10
```
Robin (oncall): 10% shift: metrics look clean. Error rate down from 30% -> 22% (tenant-level). No backend errors in eu-west-2.
Maya (SRE): 30% shift executing. Watching KV miss rate and cache warm-up.
Chris (Infra): Noting increased egress on privatelink. Bandwidth ok. No packet drops observed.
Samir (Eng-Platform): 60% shift now.
Robin (oncall): At 60% we see sustained improvement: error rate 7%. Latency stabilized.
Elaine (Account Exec): Aurelia confirms reduced failures on their side. They report their jobs resumed.
Aurelia-SRE (customer): Confirming — inference failures have dropped to <1%. Thanks team.
Samir (Eng-Platform): Moving to 100% now.
Robin (oncall): 100% traffic in eu-west-2. Monitoring for 10 minutes before marking as resolved.
Maya (SRE): Running post-shift validations: log checks, sampling responses for correctness, and checking for stale KV keys. All green so far.
Chris (Infra): DNS TTL propagation check: dig shows CNAME -> lb-eu-west-2-aurelia across major resolvers.
Samir (Eng-Platform): Noted a small client with pinned IPs still hitting eu-west-1; we added an overlay rule to allow new LB to accept requests for their IPs. Also opened a support ticket to advise customer to remove pinned IPs.
Robin (oncall): Handoff: I’ll stay primary for next 30 minutes to watch the canary, then hand to Maya for baseline monitoring.
Maya (SRE): I’ll take the 2-hour follow-up shift. Will keep dashboards up and set alert thresholds tighter for tenant-specific 5xxs.
Elaine (Account Exec): Customer updated: full traffic moved, degradation resolved. Engineering will follow up with postmortem and recommended long-term fix (improve VPC peering redundancy + BGP health checks).
Aurelia-SRE (customer): Appreciate the quick action. Please share postmortem and any API keys/whitelisting changes we need to make.
Samir (Eng-Platform): Action items captured: 
- infra: harden VPC peering for aurelia-corp (Chris)
- platform: improve routing fallback automation for dedicated tenants (Samir)
- SRE: postmortem + RCA & mitigation checklist (Maya)
- sales/AE: coordinate customer comms and runbook review (Elaine)
Robin (oncall): Incident status: mitigated -> traffic shifted successfully to eu-west-2. Customer impact: degraded for ~18 minutes. Will follow up with incident postmortem thread.
ops-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) by Robin. Metrics back to normal.
